$comment: The files the touched-page reload is measured on, and its baselines. Read by the viewer's harness (fixtures.ts, report.ts, gate.ts) and by the desktop's bench (crates/laminapdf-desktop-engine/benches/reload.rs) and gate (tools/xtask/src/desktop_reload.rs), so the sizes have one home. Each file is `pages` pages of text with one image of seeded noise of `side` by `side` pixels. A baseline is the median of the first runs on the CI runner, in ms; null until it is recorded, and a figure with no baseline is reported, never gated. A gated figure fails over max(1.2 x baseline, baseline + 10 ms).
